proposal.title: Paper-informed bounded capacity test
proposal.hypothesis: A budget-capped random_forest_regressor configuration informed by the MethodCard can reduce the large_move and fold_21 errors without weakening other slices.
proposal.problem_statement: Worst fold is fold_21 with MAE 0.011334; fold MAE CV is 69.85%. Large-move MAE is 2.56× quiet-regime MAE; this is a realized-target slice, not a tradeable ex-ante regime classifier.

evidence.claim: The proposal preserves the paper-family method and uses pinned protocol evidence.
evidence.quote: Logistic regression, decision tree and random forest are compared.

evidence.claim: The next experiment targets the observed weak slice and fold instability.
evidence.quote: Worst fold is fold_21 with MAE 0.011334; fold MAE CV is 69.85%. Large-move MAE is 2.56× quiet-regime MAE; this is a realized-target slice, not a tradeable ex-ante regime classifier.

proposal.expected_outcome: Improve rmse by at least 1.0% relative with no material MAE slice regression.
safeguards: Use earlier development folds for diagnosis and reserve later chronological folds for promotion.
Reuse the frozen dataset, target rows, chronological folds, and task fingerprint.
Permit only allow-listed model parameters inside declared bounds.
A passing child becomes a research candidate only; deployment remains unauthorized.
Do not call an LLM or external API during training.
stop_conditions: Stop after one child experiment; never generate another proposal from the promotion holdout.
Stop when the runtime budget is exceeded.
Retain the parent if the primary metric misses its hurdle or a safety slice regresses.
